_README: Fixtures for scripts/smoke-windowed.mjs. The smoke drives the SAME desktop/dist
bundle the Tauri app loads, but outside the native shell, so window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__
is shimmed and these are the answers it gives. Only commands whose SHAPE is certain
belong here: resolving a guessed shape replaces a component's well-formed initial
state with a half-built one and throws inside render, which turns condition 1 into
noise on every view at once. Anything absent REJECTS, which leaves the component on
its own initial state - the unfed shape these detectors are meant to judge.
get_settings is the exception that MUST be present: App.tsx gates the entire UI on it
(if (bootError && !settings) return <boot error screen>), so without it there are no
views to walk. It was generated from the AppSettings interface in desktop/src/App.tsx.
If that interface gains a required field, this file goes stale - and the driver fails
loudly with FIXTURE STALE rather than reporting a wall of fake structural findings.
